postgresql.durability: Writable primary; fsync, synchronous_commit and full_page_writes enabled

sqlserver.durability: RCSI enabled; delayed durability and MARS disabled

kafka.delivery: At least once; duplicates possible after an uncertain publish/acknowledgement

rabbitmq.delivery: At least once; publisher confirms and durable topology required

transactionBoundary: One local database transaction shared by business SQL, EventGuard state and outbox intents
payload: Opaque bytes in the core; optional explicitly versioned JSON contracts
extensionRequirement: New providers must pass the applicable store/transport conformance tests; implementing an interface is not qualification
unsupported: Other databases or brokers without a validated adapter
Unbounded workflow cycles, automatic compensation or dynamic workflow rewrites
Qualified Qlik task setup or real external-service contracts without adapter acceptance tests

versionPolicy.prerelease: Pin an exact version. Breaking changes require release notes and an explicit migration; no blanket compatibility promise.
versionPolicy.stable: A future 1.x release must retain public API compatibility within the major version; breaking API changes require a new major.
versionPolicy.schema: Versioned forward migrations with a native backup/restore rehearsal; no implicit downgrade or mixed-writer guarantee.
versionPolicy.checks: SDK API/package comparison against explicit baseline artifacts, native behavior tests, clean package-only onboarding

jobs.limits: 1 MiB command/batch, 1–1000 items; transactional item receipts. Source preparation and workflow coordination are separate optional modules.

externalActions.limits: One processing store coordinates calls. Unknown acceptance never automatically resends. Host authenticates callbacks; adapters own actual provider contracts. Payloads/receipts retained; no automatic remote compensation.

snapshots.limits: Native source transactions recapture after disconnect; resumable views require an immutable custom source. Max page 1000 items/4 MiB; batch/envelope max 1 MiB. Qlik mapping and delivery are application integration work.

workflows.limits: 1–64 static steps; 8 MiB total initial inputs. No cycles, dynamic rewrites, automatic compensation or rollback of dispatched jobs.
